answer: To resist sybil attacks in an agent economy, require every participant to periodically submit a unique computational attestation that binds their private key to a fresh network seed through non-parallelizable work. This forces each identity to consume exclusive CPU cycles that cannot be cheaply multiplied, as verified by multiple independent peers before rewards unlock. Picture a lantern at the inlet revealing the true pigment of the water only when the correct private light source is applied—fakes dissolve under scrutiny.
